onAttack: FIGHT lowers an enemy's HP. That is all it does.
The dummy is still here. Violence was optional.
onAct: ACT is how you deal with an enemy without fighting.|Every enemy has its own options.|Some of them are the only way to end a fight peacefully.
CHECK shows you an enemy's HP and ATK.|When you don't know what an enemy does, start there.
Talking is a real move here. Remember that.
onSpare: MERCY ends a fight without killing.|It only works once the enemy is ready to be spared.

moves.name: White Line
moves.description: A white line with a gap in it.

warn: Move with the ARROW KEYS.|Get into the gap.
hit: WHITE always hurts you.|Move into the gap and try again.

warn: This one has no gap. It will pass through you.|BLUE only hurts you if you MOVE.|Let go of the keys. Stand still.
hit: You moved.|BLUE only hurts you if you move. Stand still.

warn: Same line. Opposite rule.|ORANGE only hurts you if you STAND STILL.|Keep walking. Move through it.
cleared: Correct.|ORANGE means keep moving.|You are ready. Show me MERCY.
hit: You stopped.|ORANGE only hurts you if you stand still. Keep moving.

descriptionByHp.text: Training Dummy - HP 20, ATK 1. It cannot be killed by being ignored.

actOptions.name: Talk
actOptions.description: You talk to the dummy. It does not talk back.
extraMessages: But you feel like it is listening.|ACT options like this one are how you raise an enemy's MERCY.

spareTextByPercent.text: The dummy isn't finished teaching you yet.
The dummy is ready to be spared.

turnNarrationByHp.text: * The Training Dummy waits. Press Z on any button to use it. Press the arrows to select options.

turnNarrationBySpare.text: * The Training Dummy waits. Press Z on any button to use it. Press the arrows to select options.
* The Training Dummy has taught you everything. Use MERCY.
